hints.title: Total Area Calculation
hints.text: Compute the sum of individual areas of all squares and divide by two to get the target half area.

hints.title: Monotonic Area Below Line
hints.text: As horizontal line y moves upward, the total square area lying below the line increases monotonically.

hints.title: Continuous Binary Search
hints.text: Binary search on y between the minimum and maximum y bounds using 60 iterations to achieve target precision.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Executes 60 binary search iterations with linear square area summation per iteration.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Algebraic piecewise solving across all intervals has complex combinatorial cases.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Operates directly on bounds with constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies binary search on real numbers using fixed iterations to satisfy floating point tolerance.
